      "source": "What once must have been an enchantingly beautiful Higher woman now looks to be a ghost of utter despair. The ghost's face looks jittery and pained whilst her wild, glowing eyes move rapidly back and forth in their sockets.\nNow and then she seems to see something and her jaw pulls back, her whole face splitting apart as she shrieks an unholy cry of pain and torment.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "这位曾经想必美得摄人心魄的高等人类女子，如今看上去只是一只彻底绝望的幽灵。她瘦弱而优雅的身躯在空中轻轻荡漾，破烂的长袍却诡异地纹丝不动。她的脸上满是抽搐与痛苦，狂乱而发亮的眼睛在眼眶里飞快地来回转动。\n她不时像是看到了什么，下颌随之向后扯开，整张脸仿佛裂成两半，发出一声充满痛苦与折磨的邪异尖啸。"
